name: planning-with-files
tagline_zh: AI 一清空就失忆？这个 Skill 把计划、发现、进度写进三个文件，/clear 后自动恢复，多步任务不再断片。
tagline_en: AI forgets after /clear? This skill saves plan, findings, progress to files, auto-recovers sessions, so.
desc_en: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.
why_zh: 同类靠记忆硬撑，它靠磁盘文件持久化，/clear 后自动续跑，是唯一把恢复机制写进工作流的方案。
why_en: Unlike memory-based planners, it persists to disk and auto-recovers after /clear—the only one with built-in session restoration.
